# UBIT GPA Calculator & Results Portal
# https://ubit-results-28.vercel.app/
# llms.txt — Machine-readable site overview for AI agents and LLM crawlers
# Format: https://llmstxt.org/

> The UBIT GPA Calculator & Results Portal is the centralized academic portal
> for BSCS Batch 2024–28 students at Umaer Basha Institute of Information
> Technology (UBIT), Department of Computer Science, University of Karachi,
> Pakistan. It provides GPA calculation, cumulative CGPA tracking, live class
> results, a target CGPA advisor, subject analytics, and a class leaderboard.

## About

This portal was built by Muhammad Asad Khan (BSCS student, Batch 2024–28)
and is maintained by the student community. It is free, open, and requires
no installation — it runs entirely in a web browser.

The site is built with React, TypeScript, Vite, Supabase, and Framer Motion.
It is deployed on Vercel.

## Key Features

- **GPA Calculator**: Calculates per-semester GPA for Semester 1, 2, and 3
  using UBIT's 4.0 grading scale. Inputs are marks (0–100) per subject.
- **CGPA Calculator**: Computes cumulative CGPA across all entered semesters
  using the formula: Total Quality Points ÷ Total Credit Hours.
- **Live Results Portal**: Shows class-wide results with student names, seat
  numbers, subject marks, computed GPA and CGPA. Searchable and sortable.
- **Target CGPA Advisor**: Given your current CGPA and remaining semesters,
  calculates the average GPA you need each future semester to hit your target.
- **Subject Analytics**: Charts showing grade distribution, best/worst subjects,
  and performance patterns across the class.
- **Leaderboard**: Anonymous class ranking by CGPA. Students can submit their
  calculated CGPA to the leaderboard. Tied to seat number for authenticated users.
- **Privacy Controls**: Students can sign in and choose to hide their results
  from the public class directory.
- **Transcript Generator**: Generates a downloadable academic transcript PDF.

## Grading Scale (UBIT 4.0 Scale)

| Marks  | Letter | Grade Points |
|--------|--------|--------------|
| 90–100 | A      | 4.0          |
| 80–89  | B+     | 3.5          |
| 70–79  | B      | 3.0          |
| 60–69  | C+     | 2.5          |
| 50–59  | C      | 2.0          |
| 40–49  | D      | 1.0          |
| 0–39   | F      | 0.0          |

Minimum passing CGPA: 2.0

## BSCS Curriculum (Batch 2024–28)

### Semester 1 (17 Credit Hours)
- Introduction to Computing — 3 credits
- Programming Fundamentals — 3 credits
- Calculus & Analytical Geometry — 3 credits
- Applied Physics — 3 credits
- English Composition & Comprehension — 3 credits
- Islamic Studies / Ethics — 2 credits

### Semester 2 (17 Credit Hours)
- Object Oriented Programming — 3 credits
- Discrete Mathematics — 3 credits
- Digital Logic Design — 3 credits
- Technical & Business Writing — 3 credits
- Linear Algebra — 3 credits
- Pakistan Studies — 2 credits

### Semester 3 (18 Credit Hours — Ongoing)
- Data Structures — 3 credits
- Database Systems — 3 credits
- Computer Organization & Assembly Language — 3 credits
- Probability & Statistics — 3 credits
- Communication & Presentation Skills — 3 credits
- Differential Equations — 3 credits

## Institution

- **Department**: Department of Computer Science (DCS)
- **Institute**: Umaer Basha Institute of Information Technology (UBIT)
- **University**: University of Karachi (UoK)
- **Location**: University Road, Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan
- **Website**: https://www.uok.edu.pk/faculties/computerscience/
- **Program**: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (BSCS)
- **Batch**: 2024–2028

## Pages

- [Home](https://ubit-results-28.vercel.app/): Landing page with institution overview
- [Results Portal](https://ubit-results-28.vercel.app/#results): Class-wide student results
- [GPA Calculator](https://ubit-results-28.vercel.app/#calculator): Semester GPA & CGPA tools
- [Target CGPA Advisor](https://ubit-results-28.vercel.app/#target-advisor): Future grade planner
- [Analytics](https://ubit-results-28.vercel.app/#analytics): Performance charts
- [Leaderboard](https://ubit-results-28.vercel.app/#leaderboard): Class ranking
- [Grading Scale](https://ubit-results-28.vercel.app/#grading): Full grade reference
- [Privacy Policy](https://ubit-results-28.vercel.app/#privacy): Data handling
- [Terms of Use](https://ubit-results-28.vercel.app/#terms): Usage terms

## API Endpoints (Public)

- `GET /api/results` — Returns all student results (privacy-filtered)
- `GET /api/leaderboard` — Returns top CGPA leaderboard entries

## Contact / Feedback

This portal is student-maintained. For issues or feedback, visit the portal
and use the built-in feedback options, or contact the maintainer through
the University of Karachi student community channels.

## License & Data

Results data is sourced from official UBIT announcements and entered by
students/admins. This portal is not officially affiliated with or endorsed
by the University of Karachi administration.
